| Fiscal year | Net sales ($M) | YoY growth |
|---|---|---|
| FY2022 | 513,983 | — |
| FY2023 | 574,785 | +11.83% |
| FY2024 | 637,959 | +10.99% |

**Interpretation:** Growth slowed from ~11.8% in FY2023 to ~11.0% in FY2024 — a deceleration of roughly 0.84 percentage points. This is a mild/modest deceleration rather than a sharp one; on a dollar basis, incremental revenue actually rose (+$60.8B in FY2023 vs. +$63.2B in FY2024), so the slowdown in the *rate* reflects the larger revenue base rather than shrinking absolute growth. If your threshold for "roughly flat" is ±1 percentage point, this would qualify as roughly flat.

ANSWER: Decelerated slightly — net sales growth slowed from ~11.8% in FY2023 ($513,983M → $574,785M) to ~11.0% in FY2024 ($574,785M → $637,959M), a ~0.8 percentage-point deceleration (essentially flat-to-modestly-slower, with absolute dollar growth actually increasing from $60.8B to $63.2B).
